INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_RIB_CUSTOMERPAYEE_SELECT_SRC
(
				 PAYEE_LIST_ID

				,BNF_PYMT_DETAILS_3
				,BNF_PYMT_DETAILS_4
				,NOTIFICATION_REF_NO
				,MAX_AMT_IN_HOMECRN
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,JSRC_FLG 
				,JTAR_FLG 
)
			SELECT 				
				 CC.PAYEE_LIST_ID
				,CC.BANK_ID
				,CC.USER_ID
				,CC.DB_TS
				,CC.CORP_ID
				,CC.BNF_ID

				,CC.DEL_FLG
				,CC.R_MOD_ID

				,CC.R_CRE_ID
				,CC.R_CRE_TIME
				,CC.CONSUMER_CD
				,CC.RECEIVE_BILLS_FLG
				,CC.AUTOPAY_FLG
				,CC.AUTOPAY_AMT
				,CC.AUTOPAY_CRN
				,CC.AUTOPAY_ACID
				,CC.AUTOPAY_BRCH_ID
				,CC.AUTOPAY_MODE
				,CC.SUBSCRIPTION_START_DATE
				,CC.ADHOC_PAYEE
				,CC.NICKNAME_CRE_ID
				,CC.BNF_PYMT_DETAILS_1
				,CC.BNF_PYMT_DETAILS_2
				,CC.BNF_PYMT_DETAILS_3
				,CC.BNF_PYMT_DETAILS_4
				,CC.NOTIFICATION_REF_NO
				,CC.MAX_AMT_IN_HOMECRN
				,CC.[FILE_NAME]
		        ,0 AS JSRC_FLG 
				,1 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM EDS.RIB_CUSTOMERPAYEE CC
			JOIN d360.STG_EDS_RIB_CUSTOMERPAYEE B 
            ON CC.PAYEE_LIST_ID = B.PAYEE_LIST_ID
			AND CC.BANK_ID = B.BANK_ID
			WHERE CC.ISLATEST = '1';

UPDATE A
SET
SCD_END_DATE = dateadd(dd,-1,@DatetoProcessed)
, ISLATEST = 0
FROM EDS.RIB_CUSTOMERPAYEE A 
INNER JOIN d360.STG_EDS_RIB_CUSTOMERPAYEE_GROUP_SRC B 
ON COALESCE(A.PAYEE_LIST_ID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.PAYEE_LIST_ID,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.BANK_ID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.BANK_ID,'-1')
AND A.ISLATEST = 1
AND B.JTAR_FLG_CNT = 1
